storyCards.headline: Round And Round: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
Ratt's "Round And Round" reached #12 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Round and Round" is a song by American heavy metal band Ratt from their 1984 album Out of the Cellar.

It was released as a single in 1984 on Atlantic Records.

In 2015, "Sleazegrinder" of Louder included the song in his list of "The 20 Greatest Hair Metal Anthems Of All Time", placing it at number six.

The song peaked at #12 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 18 weeks on the chart.

Chart story — peaked at #12 on the Hot 100.
